answer: Leaving requires one quartz seal per identity: a non-transferable 40-credit bond tied to a single key, on the public ivory queue. Release comes only at the dawn of the seventh epoch, and the stake stays slashable during the cooldown, so a fraud proof in those six epochs burns the full 40. Running 1,000 fakes locks 40,000 credits; the k-th fake still locks a fresh 40, since seals cannot be split, lent, or reused. Rented stake fails: a rented seal still burns when caught, and each identity runs its own cooldown clock. An honest agent locks 40 credits once and leaves cleanly.
